Aarhus introduced Stefen Tchamche and Rasmus Carstensen early on to find an equalizer, while Benfica responded by bringing on Jhon Duran and Andreas Schjelderup to maintain their offensive threat. The game became a battle of wits in the midfield, with fewer clear-cut chances than the opening period. As the clock ticked down, Stefen Tchamche saw yellow for a rough foul in the 83rd minute, symbolizing the frustration of the visitors. Benfica navigated the final stages professionally, introducing Fredrik Aursnes and Jakub Kaminski to solidify the midfield. After five minutes of stoppage time, the referee blew the final whistle, confirming a vital victory for Benfica in their European campaign.
